node_definition.done_when: Implement topology.read, the single topology authority of plan converged-forward-solve section 2, following the design document docs/research/converged-forward-solve-design.html (sections "Topology: one field and one axis-connected component", the per-resolution budgets table and the interface-tests table) and the plan's locked decisions topology-authority, membership, field-representation and acceptance. Replace Topology.read and read_with_connectivity in nova/equilibrium/topology.py in place with one pure traced function whose operands are the booked current's Biot coupling to the hex carrier, the wall units, the convention (sigma from COCOS, never from an observed flux ordering) and a TopologyPolicy carried by ForwardSolvePolicy in nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py (extended, not duplicated); its result is one fixed-shape TopologyRead pytree as the design's data table names it. The field is the own-node six-coefficient quadratic everywhere except the saddle cell, whose support is built from the null's normal form (position, Hessian eigen-directions, curvature corrections), never from level-set roots; the null position, gradient and Hessian are evaluated from the Biot coupling kernels' analytic derivatives of the booked current, never by differentiating the mesh flux. Membership is the per-cell plasma area fraction in [0, 1] from the exact clip of the axis-connected component; fragments join only across shared-edge intervals of nonzero extent, a saddle touch does not join interiors, and a private-flux fragment in the same cell as a core fragment is excluded. Refusals (capacity excess, singular representation, unresolved ties, no qualified axis) travel as a traced validity bit and integer reason code, never as a plausible read. Callers of the replaced functions inside nova/equilibrium are re-pointed at topology.read in this node so the package imports and the existing fast suite collects; routes the design inventory marks for deletion at section 6 are left in place and untouched. Done when, on the weak-rotation limited analytic state and the diverted single-null analytic state at 132, 300, 550, 1074 and 2616 realised cells, a new test module tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py passes these rows and the log of the run is committed as evidence: test_topology_class_and_membership[analytic-row] (axis and every admitted X-point within one pitch of the analytic position; per-cell area fraction within the design budget C*(h/R0)^p for that case, saddle-neighbourhood cells budgeted separately from smooth-boundary cells, fitted order asserted at least p; limited reported as limited and diverted as diverted; qualification verdict a separate output); test_saddle_support_order[analytic-row] (five-rung probe on the diverted state, saddle-cell membership error converging at order at least 2, which the half-order level-set measurement in the design does not reach); test_null_position_implicit_tangent[analytic-row] (JVP of the null position through the implicit function theorem on grad psi = 0 with the kernel Hessian agrees with central differences; a singular Hessian gives an explicit tangent refusal); test_topology_shift_fails_position_clause[analytic-row] as the negative control (analytic flux translated vertically by three pitches against the fixed wall and mesh: the read's nulls sit at least three pitches from the unshifted analytic positions and the one-pitch clause fails, while the unshifted arm qualifies); and test_topology_read_traces (jax.jit and jax.vmap over a batch of two flux states trace and return results identical to the eager read). Record in the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-topology-read.html the per-rung membership errors and fitted orders for both cases in an HTML table, the compile wall and peak host RSS of the traced read at 2616 cells, the five-rung saddle probe, and one line-contour poloidal panel per case at 550 cells drawn with the nova.media painters (solved nulls and analytic nulls in their own styles, the wall units, no axes or gridlines) saved under docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/cfs-topology-read/ and cited with project-absolute src; the fragment carries plan-evidence-for converged-forward-solve and reckon audit-doc reports 0 errors. Receipts above a few MB (npz, gz, json) live under /work/projects/imas_gpu/sophelio/nova-receipts/converged-forward-solve/cfs-topology-read/ with the path recorded in the fragment; PNG and SVG stay in git. The gate runs on compute, never on the login node: first on the H200 through RECKON_ALLOW_NESTED_LAUNCH=1 scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh --log <absolute log> --wait -- tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py -vv, falling back to --partition=titan only when a real betelgeuse submission is still pending on a resource or configuration reason, and the manifest names the job id, the platform printed in the log header and the cache guard rows. Every uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync; on a compute node uv is not invoked at all, the shared environment's interpreter runs directly with PYTHONPATH set to the worktree. configure_dtypes() is called before any array is built and jax_enable_x64 is asserted True in the test module. Commit with a conventional subject and a body; the manifest's commits line lists every commit.
